title: Banks Act Circular C7/2016 — Matters related to specified minority interests, that is, non-controlling interests, in shares and/or instruments qualifying as capital
enablingLegislation: Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This circular is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Matters related to specified minority interests, that is, non-controlling interests, in shares and/or instruments qualifying as capital.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This circular applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Matters related to specified minority interests, that is, non-controlling interests, in shares and/or instruments qualifying as capital.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Matters related to specified minority interests, that is, non-controlling interests, in shares and/or instruments qualifying as capital. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This circular remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
